svg.title: COMPSCI 764 full project implementation map
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom architecture map for native Windows development, GitHub version control, Colab GPU execution, official CAD release validation, Google Drive artefact storage, controlled dataset construction, fixed CAD training, and fixed RAG evaluation.
svg.text: Semantic minimal-pair supervision for a fixed CAD-derived RAG trust scorer · Version 4.1 · 19 September 2026
Code stays in GitHub; compute happens on temporary Colab storage; only validated artefacts persist in Drive.
Upstream evidence, governance, and scientific freeze gates
Validate the official release and resolve representation provenance before producing final features.
Split by pair family before expansion; equalise augmentation budgets; validate leakage and provenance.
Fixed CAD-derived feature, training, and offline evaluation pipeline
Change only the selected training rows; keep representation, encoder, architecture, training recipe, validation, and tests fixed.
Replay the same retrieved passages; switch only the CAD checkpoint; never train the generator.
